references.text: The fulfillment of the prophecy that the land would receive its sabbatical years while the people were in exile in Babylon. The land rested for seventy years to fulfill the Lord's word through Jeremiah.

The sabbatical year for the land that Israel was to observe every seventh year, when the earth was to rest. This is the basis for the sabbath rest the land would receive during the time of desolation.
The same context in which the land will be compensated for its sabbatical years while it lies desolate and the people are in exile because of their sin.
Jeremiah's prophecy that the land would lie desolate for seventy years, corresponding to the unfulfilled sabbatical years.
The Lord's promise that after seventy years He would look after His people and bring them back to the land.
Daniel understood from the writings that the destruction of Jerusalem would last seventy years, based on the principle of sabbatical years.
The immediate context describing how the people will be scattered among the nations and the land will lie desolate.
